fences.rule: If the setting only lets a pattern spread across private memories become recordable, it is Room for strangers there; if what is compared on the wall expires, so the wall needs a clock and a stale offer on it is a lie, it is here.
fences.case: The trucking load board that put every posted load on one screen where before the only wall was inside one broker's head.

fences.rule: If a rule makes the party at fault build an honest instrument, it is Silence priced as guilt there; if no such rule was written and the market lives on exactly the seller's own witness's credit, what the market inherits is here.
fences.case: Carbon offsets verified by auditors the seller hires, which shrank all together in 2023 when one forest methodology was doubted.

fences.rule: If the place in the queue is named as the good that changes hands, it is Priority there; if the line is read as a price already being paid and a market is born as a parasite on someone else's rationing, it is here.
fences.case: Reservation resellers pricing the tables a restaurant gave away free until New York banned the resale in 2024.

fences.rule: If the length of the line is read as the wait of the next arrival given the throughput, it is the Queue clock there; if the same line is read as the price the good already carries, it is here.
fences.case: The line outside the restaurant, read as what a table costs rather than as how long the next diner waits.

fences.rule: If a market that was clearing stops being one behind its quote, the death is there; a death or a manipulation is here only where it poisons a precondition before the market is made, as wash trades seeding the comps.
fences.case: A grade whose issuer's word stops meaning anything, so lots stop substituting in a market that had been clearing for years.

fences.rule: If the question is what a price becomes one level up when a matching engine pairs private bets into a public number, it is the Order-book alembic there; if the question is what must exist for two offers to be seen on one wall before any price, it is here.
fences.case: The matching engine that turns each holder's private guess into a public number.
